---
title: "Try out Other Summary Functions: Orben 2019 (NHB)"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

# Overview

## Load Data

```{r yrbs-load-data}
mv_yrbs_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_yrbs")
mv_yrbs_onehot <- mv_yrbs_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_yrbs <- mv_yrbs_org
mv_yrbs
```

```{r mtf-load-data}
mv_mtf_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mtf")
mv_mtf_onehot <- mv_mtf_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_mtf <- mv_mtf_org
mv_mtf
```

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs_org <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total")
mv_mcs_onehot <- mv_mcs_org |>
  expand_y_variable()
mv_mcs <- mv_mcs_org
mv_mcs
```

# Analysis

## YRBS

```{r}
mv_yrbs
```

DECIDE default score

```{r yrbs-between-bucket}
decide_yrbs <- decide_vec(mv_yrbs, colname_metric = "effect")
decide_yrbs
```

```{r yrbs-between-bucket-plot}
vis_importance(decide_yrbs)
```

Try out other functions

```{r decide-range-max-yrbs}
decide_range_max_yrbs <- decide_vec(
  mv_yrbs,
  colname_metric = "effect",
  spread = function(x) { diff(range(x)) },
  summary = max
)
decide_range_max_yrbs
```

```{r decide-range-max-yrbs-vis}
vis_importance(decide_range_max_yrbs)
```
